

 
## Incipit

 

Buffalo 7th Nov 1856

 

Sunday Evening *Windy* & *Rain*

 

Brother Nelson & Family

 

Your last letter came duly to hand & found us as it left you all in a very comfortable state of health

 

We of course were glad to hear from you once more, indeed as always are glad to hear from you one & all -- you write that all are at home -- please say to William that I should be pleased to have him write to me whenever he feels like it, as also Frances they both owe me one I think, and if my namesake or Candace will write I will answer
